in_marathi.name: Neilesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neilesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neilesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Naila', meaning God or divine, and 'Ish', meaning lord or ruler. This name is often given to a child believed to be a messenger of the gods. In Hindu mythology, Neilesh is also the name of the god of the forest and protector of animals.

vedic_reference.note: The name Neilesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'neta' (leader, guide) and 'ishvara' (lord, god). In Hindu mythology, the term 'neta' is often used to refer to a leader or guide, while 'ishvara' represents the supreme god or controller of the universe.
